# Autoškola kvíz

> Bezplatný trenažér testů autoškoly pro Českou republiku: všech 1136 oficiálních zkušebních
> otázek Ministerstva dopravy (eTesty), procvičování podle okruhů, krátká denní dávka,
> opakování chyb a zkušební test ve formátu skutečné zkoušky (25 otázek, 30 minut).
> Bez registrace, bez reklam, bez cookies; funguje offline (PWA) i na mobilu. Česky.

## What it is
- A practice app for the Czech driving-licence theory exam ("testy autoškoly").
- Question bank: the official public exam questions of the Ministry of Transport
  (https://etesty.md.gov.cz/), 1136 questions in the official wording, grouped by okruh
  (pravidla provozu, dopravní značky, dopravní situace, zásady bezpečné jízdy, zdravotnická
  příprava, …) plus a timed mock exam.
- Learning design: free topic choice, mastery per okruh instead of grades, immediate
  self-correcting feedback, missed questions resurface via spaced repetition. No streak guilt,
  no paywall, no lives.
- Free forever, no account needed; optional Google / magic-link sign-in only to sync progress
  between devices. Only first-party anonymous usage counts, no third-party trackers.

## How to use it
- https://autoskola.dravec.org/ — pick an okruh, run the daily set, or start a mock exam;
  progress is kept on the device.
- Topic pages are real URLs, e.g. https://autoskola.dravec.org/okruh/dopravni-znacky/
  (all of them are listed in the sitemap).

## Data & provenance
- Questions and answer keys are the official public bank; the app shows the official wording
  unchanged. Bank source and counts: https://autoskola.dravec.org/ (footer) and
  https://github.com/Chartres/autoskola-kviz/blob/main/data/README.md
- A study aid, not the exam: the official test is taken at the driving school / municipal office.
